name: Cutaways and Ghosting
definition: Cutaways remove occluding objects to reveal structures of interest, using a simplified three-object setup (Background, Ghost, Selection) with static importance functions to skip costly importance compositing.
summary: Cutaways and Ghosting are volume rendering techniques that selectively suppress occluding background structures to reveal primary objects, distinguishing themselves by explicitly managing occlusion through opacity reduction rather than edge enhancement.
